rule: Each maturity dimension is independent. Promotion in one dimension MUST NOT promote another dimension.

artifact.rationale: Immutable stable-install machinery and negative integrity tests exist on the v0.5 development branch, but v0.5.0 has not been promoted/tagged as the stable release.

contract_api.rationale: Portable contracts are executable and tested, but their v0.5 versions remain unreleased candidate contracts.

runtime_adapter.rationale: Hermes and Codex reference adapters pass conformance and the bounded canonical Siti case is verified across both runtimes, but the adapter contract remains an unreleased v0.5 candidate.

behavioral_evidence.rationale: Bounded controlled live cases now include a verified Hermes+Codex Siti portability reference case. This remains evaluated-case evidence, not repeated/general behavior, and does not promote real-world workflow or provider-lifecycle maturity.

real_world_workflow.rationale: The canonical real-task baseline is 1/20 eligible cases and preserves its one known failure; publication/demonstration gate is closed.

provider_lifecycle.rationale: Playwright has a bounded completed live evaluation, while Browser Use and Cognee remain NOT_RUN and the clean-machine Hermes lifecycle remains deferred.

historical_truth.rule: Do not rewrite v0.4 UNPROVEN, NOT_RUN, or COLLECTING evidence states when describing v0.5 maturity.
